title_en: Weekly Petroleum Status Report Summary, week ending October 30, 2026
title_ja: EIA：10月30日終了週の商業石油在庫が減少
original_text:
For the week ending October 30, 2026, U.S. refineries processed 16.7 million barrels per day (b/d), up 199,000 b/d from the previous week, at 94.5% capacity utilization. Gasoline output averaged 9.7 million b/d, and distillate production decreased to 5.2 million b/d.

Crude oil imports decreased 1,000 b/d to 6.4 million b/d, although the four-week average of 6.1 million b/d is 9.5% above the year-ago level. Gasoline imports averaged 351,000 b/d; distillate imports averaged 117,000 b/d.
Commercial crude oil inventories (excluding the Strategic Petroleum Reserve) decreased 0.9 million barrels to 409.8 million barrels, 4% below the five-year average. Gasoline inventories decreased 0.2 million barrels, 2% below the five-year average. Distillate inventories decreased 3.6 million barrels, 13% below the five-year average. Propane/propylene inventories decreased 1.6 million barrels, 10% above the five-year average.
Total commercial petroleum inventories decreased by 8.2 million barrels for the week.

Over the past four weeks, total product supplied averaged 21.2 million b/d, up 4.2% year over year. The four-week average for gasoline product supplied decreased 0.4% year over year to 8.6 million b/d, while the four-week average for distillate product supplied increased 8.7% to 4.2 million b/d. The four-week average for jet fuel product supplied decreased 2.8% year over year.
translation_ja:
2026年10月30日終了週の米製油所の原油処理量は日量1,670万バレルで、前週から19万9,000バレル増加。設備稼働率は94.5％。ガソリン生産は日量970万バレル、留出油生産は日量520万バレルへ減少した。

原油輸入は日量1,000バレル減の640万バレル。4週間平均は日量610万バレルで前年同期を9.5％上回った。ガソリン輸入は日量35万1,000バレル、留出油輸入は日量11万7,000バレル。

戦略石油備蓄を除く商業原油在庫は90万バレル減の4億980万バレルで、過去5年平均を4％下回った。ガソリン在庫は20万バレル減で5年平均を2％下回った。留出油在庫は360万バレル減で5年平均を13％下回った。プロパン・プロピレン在庫は160万バレル減で5年平均を10％上回った。
商業石油在庫全体は週間で820万バレル減少した。

過去4週間の石油製品供給量は平均日量2,120万バレルで前年同期比4.2％増。ガソリン供給量の4週間平均は日量860万バレルで前年同期比0.4％減、留出油は日量420万バレルで8.7％増。ジェット燃料は前年同期比2.8％減だった。
